identificationModule.briefTitle: Maximal Cytoreductive Therapies on Post-treatment Metastases in Pts With mHSPC During Apalutamide Plus ADT Treatment
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Prospective Study of Maximal-Cytoreductive Therapies for Patients With de Novo Metastatic Hormone-sensitive Prostate Cancer Who Achieve Oligopersistent Metastases During Systemic Treatment With Apalutamide Plus ADT (CHAMPION Study)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To assess the feasibility and safety of Maximal cytoreductive therapies in patients with de novo mCSPC who achieve ≤10 oligopersistent metastases on PSMA PET CT after initial 3-month systemic treatment with apalutamide plus ADT. Maximal cytoreductive therapies consist of 1.cytoreductive radical prostatectomy with/without PLND guided by post-treatment PET 2.metastasis-directed therapy with radiation guided by post-treatment oligopersistent metastases. All patients receive continuous systemic treatment with apalutamide plus ADT.

armGroups.label: maximal-cytoreductive therapy
armGroups.description: Patients with de novo mCSPC who achieve ≤10 oligopersistent metastases on PSMA PET CT after initial 3-month systemic treatment with apalutamide plus ADT will receive cytoreductive radical prostatectomy with/without PLND and metastasis-directed therapy with radiation.
interventionNames: Procedure: cytoreductive radical prostatectomy with/without pelvic lymph node dissection

interventions.name: cytoreductive radical prostatectomy with/without pelvic lymph node dissection
interventions.description: Patients receive cytoreductive radical prostatectomy with/without pelvic lymph node dissection.

interventions.name: metastasis-directed therapy with radiation
interventions.description: Patients receive metastasis-directed therapy with radiation guided by post-treatment oligopersistent metastases.

primaryOutcomes.measure: proportion of patients with undetectable PSA level after 6 cycles of treatment (each cycle is 28 days).
primaryOutcomes.description: It is defined as the proportion of patients with PSA≤0.2 ng/mL without disease progression or symptomatic deterioration after 6 cycles of study treatment (each cycle is 28 days).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end of the 6th cycle of treatment (each cycle is 28 days).

secondaryOutcomes.measure: proportion of patients with undetectable PSA level after 3 cycles of treatment (each cycle is 28 days).
secondaryOutcomes.description: It is defined as the proportion of patients with PSA≤0.2 ng/mL after 3 cycles of study treatment (each cycle is 28 days).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end of the 3rd cycle of treatment (each cycle is 28 days).

secondaryOutcomes.measure: PSA50 response rate and PSA90 response rate at the end of the 3rd treatment cycle (each cycle is 28 days).
secondaryOutcomes.description: It is defined as the proportion of patients with a PSA reduction of over 50% / 90%compared with baseline.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end of the 3rd cycle of treatment (each cycle is 28 days).

secondaryOutcomes.measure: PSA50 response rate and PSA90 response rate at the end of the 6th treatment cycle (each cycle is 28 days).
secondaryOutcomes.description: It is defined as the proportion of patients with a PSA reduction of over 50% / 90%compared with baseline.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end of the 6th cycle of treatment (each cycle is 28 days).

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Conventional imaging and PSMA-PET/CT imaging features at baseline
Proportion of patients with ≤ 10 metastases on PSMA-PET/CT imaging at the end of the third treatment cycle (each cycle is 28 days).
secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of patients with ≤ 10 metastases on PSMA-PET/CT imaging at the end of the third treatment cycle (each cycle is 28 days).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end of the 3rd cycle of treatment (each cycle is 28 days).

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Comparison of imaging features between conventional imaging and PSMA PET/CT.
secondaryOutcomes.description: Including prostate volume, tumor burden, distribution of metastatic lesions etc.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end of the 3rd and 6th cycle of treatment (each cycle is 28 days).

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Feasibility and safety of performing cRP±MDT treatment
secondaryOutcomes.description: Feasibility and safety of performing cRP±MDT guided by oligopersistent metastases assessed by PSMA PET/CT
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end of the 6th cycle of treatment (each cycle is 28 days).
